one_liner: LiveAgent helpdesk has a documented REST API v3 with admin-generated API keys, plus an official built-in MCP server; access requires a 30-day trial or paid plan.
auth_notes: The REST API v3 uses an admin-generated API key sent in a request header. OAuth 2.1 (Authorization Code + PKCE) is documented only for the MCP server. The Python SDK also mentions an OAuth2 'privileges' scope, but a general OAuth flow for the REST API is unconfirmed. Keys are per-account, so each customer needs their own domain and key.
access_notes: A 30-day free trial with no credit card is available and can be used to test the API. Beyond that, a paid plan is needed. An AppSumo free account is mentioned only in a changelog fix and isn't a documented free tier. The MCP server is listed under Enterprise features, but the MCP docs don't clearly restrict it to that plan.
blocker_notes: There is no free tier. Access comes through a 30-day trial or a paid plan. Each customer also has its own domain and manually generated API key, so setup is per customer.

evidence.quote: While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API which loads the API v3 section where you find existing API keys or add a new one.
OAuth 2.1 (Authorization Code + PKCE) or Bearer token
Consider registering a new free Trial account for testing purposes, before using API with your live account.
Choose the object (agents, tickets, .) & method (get, post, delete) and press the "Try it out" button
LiveAgent exposes a built-in **MCP server** (Model Context Protocol) that lets you connect external AI tools
